data_dictionary.rr: First acceptable candidate reciprocal rank; submitted positive cases only
data_dictionary.system_mrr: Mean original-system RR on the same submitted positive cases with original order available
data_dictionary.mean_delta_rr: Mean participant-minus-original-system RR on submitted positive cases
data_dictionary.condition_summaries: The same quality and missingness metrics restricted to each server-assigned condition
data_dictionary.correct_to_wrong: Count of natural submitted positives changing original correct top-1 to participant wrong/empty top-1
data_dictionary.wrong_to_correct: Count of natural submitted positives changing original wrong top-1 to participant correct top-1
data_dictionary.draft_response: Current recoverable unsubmitted answer; never included in submitted quality denominators
data_dictionary.raw_gap_seconds: Server receipt interval preceding a reconnect report; activity remains self-reported and uncertain
data_dictionary.missing: Unsubmitted cases are excluded from quality denominators
data_dictionary.raw_elapsed_seconds: Seconds from the first accepted usable-content server receipt to ranking submission for that presentation, including breaks and gaps; null when either endpoint is missing. Later page-ready events do not restart this interval.
data_dictionary.observed_segment_seconds: Compatibility alias of case timing.page_observation_seconds in analysis/3; page-seconds, not unique elapsed coverage or active duration.
data_dictionary.first_response: First intentional submitted ranking, otherwise null; recoverable draft is separate
data_dictionary.test: Synthetic/preview records excluded unless include_test is explicitly requested
data_dictionary.questionnaire_answer_states: answered, skipped, not_answered; free text omitted from anonymous export
data_dictionary.tutorial_outcomes: First/final synthetic comprehension attempts and eventual completion; descriptive preparation data, not a validated expertise score
data_dictionary.consultation: Per-case reported method combinations; no per-candidate attribution or causal interpretation; missing resource_scope remains unknown
data_dictionary.unavailable_intervals: Raw late/pre-ready intervals and their reasons are retained; unavailable intervals never contribute page counts or page-seconds.
data_dictionary.page_observation_seconds: Page-seconds: sum of accepted bounded, deduplicated, non-overlapping eligible client intervals, grouped by stage/case. Excludes availability=unavailable; zero means no observed page-seconds, never zero elapsed task time. May exceed raw elapsed seconds.
data_dictionary.per_page_observation_seconds: Deterministically ordered page_instance_id and seconds pairs from the same eligible intervals as page_observation_seconds; each monotonic clock is local to one page. Never compare offsets across pages or infer concurrency/disjointness.
data_dictionary.page_instance_count: Count of page clocks with eligible intervals for this stage/case; not a concurrency measure.
data_dictionary.coverage_status: Always not_established: no validated mapping from client monotonic clocks to the server ready/submit interval exists.
data_dictionary.coverage_reason: no_eligible_observations for zero contributing pages, single_page_clock_unmapped for one, multiple_page_clocks for more than one; neither overlap nor disjointness is established.
data_dictionary.unique_elapsed_coverage_seconds: Null means unknown elapsed coverage in seconds, even for one page. It is never the raw page sum or a clamped value.
data_dictionary.unobserved_elapsed_seconds: Null means unknown elapsed time without observations in seconds; never computed by subtracting page-seconds from raw elapsed seconds.
data_dictionary.active_duration_known: Always false: page observations, visibility and receipt timestamps do not establish attention or active task duration; hidden pages are not implicitly paused.
data_dictionary.tutorial_observed_seconds: Compatibility alias of session tutorial_timing.page_observation_seconds; tutorial/practice page-seconds, excluded from scored case time.
data_dictionary.consultation_observed_seconds: Compatibility alias of case consultation_timing.page_observation_seconds; consultation page-seconds, excluded from scored case time.
data_dictionary.tutorial_timing: Observation summary for tutorial/practice stages with no scored case, independently grouped per session. Preparation outcomes do not change ranking-quality denominators.
data_dictionary.consultation_timing: Observation summary for consultation stage of this case only, independent of scored case observations.
data_dictionary.protocol_versions: Frozen source publication protocol versions copied unchanged at data.protocol_versions; the export derivation schema is separate.
data_dictionary.source_protocol_versions: Manifest copy of the unchanged source publication versions, including its frozen export default; source study_revision and content_sha256 bind the derived result.
data_dictionary.analysis_schema: manifest.schema=exact-study-analysis/3 identifies corrected derived semantics; archive_schema=exact-study-csv/3 is its CSV representation. Saved archives retain their original schema and hash.
data_dictionary.csv_nulls: Nested JSON summary values retain null. Top-level nullable scalar CSV cells are empty, meaning unknown/missing rather than zero; dictionaries and JSON are authoritative.

data.resource_scope_analysis_rule: Describe supplied-only, different/additional, unsure and unanswered separately; no outcome-dependent exclusion.
